tags.name: Aggro
tags.description: Low-cost Units (often a swarm of them) that pressure from turn one and steal Gigs before the rival can stabilize. Cheap cards over late-game power; loses if the rival stabilizes the board.

tags.name: Midrange
tags.description: Efficient mid-cost Units backed by Gear and a little removal. Flexible: plays tempo against slow decks and defends against fast ones, and wins fights on the board before attacking for Gigs.

tags.name: Control
tags.description: Answers the rival's Units one by one with removal and bottom-deck effects, denies Gigs, and draws cards to keep up. Gives up early ground, then stabilizes and wins late on a cleared board.

tags.name: Tempo
tags.description: Uses cheap interaction (spending rival Units, power shrink, bottom-deck, adjusting Gigs) to disrupt the rival's turn so they never develop, while a few efficient threats keep attacking.

tags.name: Combo / Engine
tags.description: Assembles a repeatable loop between specific cards and Legends (for example a Program or Braindance engine) and wins through it. Powerful when it runs, weak if the pieces are disrupted.

tags.name: Ramp / Resource Acceleration
tags.description: Speeds up the Eddie curve with extra Eddies and cost discounts so expensive Units arrive far ahead of schedule, then overwhelms the rival with them.

tags.name: Hand Control
tags.description: Strips the rival's hand (discard when you steal a Gig and similar effects) and grinds with card advantage so the rival runs out of options. A slow, late-game plan.

tags.name: Gear / Equip
tags.description: Loads cheap Gear onto sturdy Units or Legends to win fights and attack through the board, drawing extra cards off Gear triggers. Gear count is high relative to Units.

tags.name: Featured
tags.description: Shown in the big Featured spot at the top of the website's Decks page.

tags.name: Competitive
tags.description: Tuned and tested for tournament play.

tags.name: Casual / Fun
tags.description: Built for fun and theme rather than raw power.

tags.name: Budget
tags.description: Cheap to build; few expensive or rare cards.

tags.name: Beginner Friendly
tags.description: Simple game plan that is easy to pilot.

tags.name: Work in Progress
tags.description: Still being tuned; cards likely to change.
